title: Why render locally?
description: An 8-second Manim explainer: render time falls like 1/cores, and a hardware video encoder takes it the rest of the way to about a minute.

requires.why: encodes the frames with the fastest encoder
reads the finished video for the report

render.engine_command: manim render src/scene.py Main --format mp4 -r 1920,1080 --fps 30 --media_dir .lr-work/media --disable_caching && ffmpeg -i .lr-work/media/videos/.../Main.mp4 <fastest encoder> why-render-locally.mp4
